correctness.rationale: Proved for every n>=3 by a bijective prism-perfect-matching decomposition, a complete signed cyclic transfer trace with exceptional even-rail terms, Lucas parity and a separate modulo-four edge-incidence argument. Six exact seed amplitudes and two zero seeds, propagated by four six-site identity blocks, attain every lower bound and construct growing zero families. The extracted standalone standard-library verifier independently computed all Walsh transforms at n=3..7, checked sign gauge cases exhaustively at n=3 and n=6, and checked witnesses through n=201. The written proof rather than the finite computation establishes universality. Normalization is unnormalized group convolution.

claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: The odd-prism statements follow from the known cycle signed-matching polynomial and are acknowledged as covered. Therefore the complete mixed even/odd theorem and its even-case pseudoinverse norms are not logical corollaries of the retrieved prior statements.

value.rationale: The exact least positive eigenvalue magnitude of a natural perfect-matching convolution operator gives its sharp Hilbert-space inverse stability. The gap unexpectedly jumps to four at even resonant circumferences, while the odd singular class has gap two; a nontrivial parity argument and the extra opposite-rail matching pair explain this structural boundary. This is an infinite-family classification with explicit null-frequency constructions, not merely a small enumeration or relabeling.
